bull_case: CUDA 개발자 생태계와 GPU·CPU·NVLink·Ethernet·시스템의 공동설계가 신제품마다 기존 설치기반과 소프트웨어를 복리화한다. Rubin·Spectrum-X·Vera CPU 확장은 고객 wallet share와 전환비용을 높인다.
bear_case: AI 가속기 하드웨어는 custom ASIC·AMD·개방형 소프트웨어로 범용화될 수 있고, 대형 고객은 자체 설계 능력을 보유한다. 소프트웨어 이식성이 높아지면 CUDA 락인이 약해질 수 있다.
thesis: 해자는 현재 넓고 방향도 대체로 확장이다. 10-K가 명시한 개발자·설치기반 효과와 unified architecture, 네트워킹·CPU 확장이 양의 피드백을 강화한다. 그러나 hyperscaler custom silicon과 소프트웨어 추상화가 멀티호밍 비용을 낮출 가능성은 실질적이다.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA's 2026 10-K states that the large and growing number of developers and installed base strengthens its ecosystem and increases platform value for customers.
The same 10-K describes a unified programmable architecture spanning hardware, systems, software, algorithms, libraries, models and services.
Networking revenue grew 18% sequentially, Spectrum-X Ethernet grew 2.6x y/y, and Grace CPU trailing-12-month revenue exceeded $5B.
evidence.value: Networking +18% q/q; Spectrum-X 2.6x; Grace CPU >$5B TTM

evidence.claim: The 10-K explicitly warns that customers can develop their own solutions and competitors may be cheaper or offer better functionality.

counterevidence: Hyperscalers can internalize accelerator design and selectively bypass NVIDIA GPUs.
Software frameworks may abstract hardware differences and lower switching costs over time.
NVLink Fusion supports custom ASICs, which can preserve ecosystem relevance but also legitimizes alternatives.
Export controls can accelerate local competitive ecosystems outside NVIDIA.
unknowns: CUDA workload portability cost in 3-5 years
Incremental margin contribution of networking/CPU/software versus GPU
Custom ASIC share of top customers' AI workloads by FY30

uncertainties.rationale: Pricing power is strong but the largest customers have credible internal alternatives.
Developer/install-base feedback is well established though not quantified in current filings.
Software abstraction and custom silicon remain credible long-term threats.

falsifiers: CUDA migration cost falls materially and major customers multihome without economic penalty.
Networking/CPU attach rates stall while custom silicon gains share.
NVIDIA gross margins and pricing power structurally erode despite growing AI demand.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current evidence points to ecosystem expansion through Rubin, networking, CPU and software rather than persistent moat shrinkage; custom silicon is a material but not yet dominant erosion signal.

key_kpis.name: Platform attach
key_kpis.threshold: Networking/CPU/software attach to GPU systems continues rising

key_kpis.name: Gross margin
key_kpis.threshold: Maintain strong margins through architecture transitions

key_kpis.name: Custom silicon displacement
key_kpis.threshold: No structural loss of major workloads at top customers

subscores.rationale: Full-stack integration and customer dependence imply high switching costs, though hyperscalers can build alternatives.
Developer/install-base effects and expanding platform components create reinforcing ecosystem value.
Multiple defense layers exist, but custom silicon and software abstraction are meaningful.
